color.note: Surfaces are warm off-whites, never pure grey. Ink is near-black with a warm cast. Clay is the one brand hue: fills, marks and icons — never small text (use clay-text). Every text token names the surfaces it reads on at 4.5:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: surface-000
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: cards, inputs, menus, dialogs. Sits on surface-100.

tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: The page canvas. Default body background.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Sunken and secondary areas: sidebars, code blocks, table headers, ghost-button hover.

tokens.name: surface-300
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed states of neutral controls; selected rows.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings, primary text, icons. On surface-000 through surface-300 (≥ 12:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Body copy and long-form reading. On surface-000 through surface-300.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: helper text, metadata, table captions, ghost-button labels. On surface-000 through surface-300 (≥ 5:1).

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Placeholders and timestamps. On surface-000 and surface-100 only (4.8:1); on surface-200/300 use ink-muted. Darkened from a typical tertiary grey so it still passes AA.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines: dividers, card and table borders, the line under a header. Decorative — never the only cue of a control's edge.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Control boundaries that must be perceived: input, select, checkbox and radio borders, the secondary button outline (≥ 3:1 on surface-000/100/200).

tokens.name: clay
tokens.usage: The brand hue. Accent-button fill, the send/submit disc, brand marks, selected-state fills, chart series 1. Pair only with on-clay. 2.96:1 against surface-100 in light — a hair under the 3:1 boundary floor, kept exact; for an outline or stroke that must be perceived on the canvas use clay-deep.

tokens.name: clay-deep
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of clay fills; the light-theme focus ring; strokes in clay that must be perceived on the canvas (3.9:1 on surface-100).

tokens.name: clay-text
tokens.usage: Clay as TEXT: badge labels, inline emphasis, active tab label. On surface-000/100/200 and on clay-soft (≥ 4.5:1 both themes). Never use clay itself for text under 24px.

tokens.name: clay-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind clay-text: brand badges, the selected item in a menu, callouts in the brand voice.

tokens.name: on-clay
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a clay or clay-deep fill (6:1). Ink, not white — white on clay is only 3.1:1, so white is allowed only for a lone icon on a clay disc, never for a label.

tokens.name: inverse
tokens.usage: Primary-button fill, tooltips, the footer band: the theme's ink used as a surface.

tokens.name: on-inverse
tokens.usage: Text and icons on inverse (≥ 17:1).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Positive status as text or icon: on surface-000/100 and on success-soft. Always with a word or check icon, never colour alone.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of success badges and alerts.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions as text, icon or the danger-button fill: on surface-000/100 and on danger-soft. Label on a danger fill is on-danger.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of error messages, danger badges and alerts.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Label on a danger fill (5.5:1 light, 9:1 dark).

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Caution as text or icon: on surface-000/100 and on warning-soft.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of warning badges and alerts.

tokens.name: warning-fill
tokens.usage: A loud highlight fill (banners, a marker). Text on it is ink.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Links and informational status as text or icon: on surface-000/100 and on info-soft (≥ 5:1).

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of info badges and alerts.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links in running text — an alias of info. Underline on hover; in editorial pages a link may instead be ink with a permanent underline.

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: Secondary accent: illustration, category tags, chart series 2. Never text; text on it is ink (6.5:1).

tokens.name: olive
tokens.usage: Secondary accent: illustration, category tags, chart series 3. Never text; text on it is ink (5.1:1).

tokens.name: fig
tokens.usage: Secondary accent: illustration, chart series 4. Never text; text on it is ink (5:1).

tokens.name: cactus
tokens.usage: Pale accent tint: illustration grounds, empty-state art, chart series 5. Text on it is ink.

tokens.name: heather
tokens.usage: Pale accent tint: illustration grounds, chart series 6. Text on it is ink.

tokens.name: manilla
tokens.usage: Paper tint: feature cards, pull-quotes, the editorial sidebar. Text on it is ink or ink-soft.

tokens.name: kraft
tokens.usage: Deeper paper tint: feature-card accents, illustration. Text on it is ink (7:1).

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim behind dialogs and sheets.

families.sans: "Instrument Sans", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif
families.mono: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

type.note: Serif for statements, sans for the interface, mono for eyebrows and code. All three are hosted Google Fonts (Newsreader, Instrument Sans, JetBrains Mono) — open-licence stand-ins for the proprietary editorial serif / warm grotesque pairing this taste comes from; swap the family stacks when you license the originals.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Newsreader at weight 400, optical size 72. Tight leading, slight negative tracking. Statements, not labels.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Section openers on landing and empty-state pages.

styles.name: display-md
styles.usage: Page titles in the app (dashboard greeting, report title).

groups.name: Headings
groups.note: Instrument Sans semibold. Structural headings inside the interface.

styles.name: heading-lg
styles.usage: Page-level headings when a serif display is too loud (settings, admin).

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Instrument Sans regular; 500 for labels. 16px is the floor for form fields.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: The order ships once payment clears.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: The order ships once payment clears.
styles.usage: Default UI text, form values, table cells.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Helper text, dense tables, secondary descriptions.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Button labels, form labels, tabs, menu items.

groups.name: Editorial
groups.note: Newsreader at text optical size for long-form reading — docs, release notes, help articles.

styles.name: prose
styles.sample: Every invoice carries a reference you can quote back to us.

groups.name: Mono
groups.note: JetBrains Mono. The eyebrow is set UPPERCASE with wide tracking.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase metadata above a display heading; section numbers; table-column keys.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap; between a label and its field.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside chips and badges; between inline controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding of small buttons and menu items; between related rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Button and input horizontal padding; between fields in a form.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Compact card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card and dialog padding; between form groups.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between sections inside a page.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Page gutter on tablet; sidebar padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between major page regions.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Top of a page below the header; editorial section gap.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Marketing section rhythm.

radius.note: Soft. Controls 8px, containers 12–24px, chips and avatars round. radius-none is the editorial option for marketing pages.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Squared buttons on marketing and editorial pages only.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, checkboxes, table cells' selection.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, menu items, tabs.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, menus, popovers, alerts.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Feature cards, image frames, the composer.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: Dialogs, sheets, large panels.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Chips, avatars, switches, icon discs.

shadow.note: Shadows are warm ink at low alpha and layered; borders do most of the work. Dark theme deepens them.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs on focus, raised cards.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, the composer.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs and sheets.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on every control: a 2px canvas gap, then 2px of solid clay-deep (light) or clay (dark) — ≥ 3.7:1 on every surface. Box-shadow, so it follows the radius.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons, chips, table-row actions.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default button, input, select height.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Large buttons, the primary CTA, touch targets.

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icons inside small controls and badges.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Icons inside default controls and menu items.

tokens.name: prose-measure
tokens.usage: Max width of long-form text.

tokens.name: container
tokens.usage: Max width of app and marketing content.

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: App navigation rail.
